name: Fazekasboda (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fazekasboda: a shield of red and blue with a yellow jug, a bunch of grapes and a tree, inscribed FAZEKASBODA above and 1724 below.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
